title: Auto-install an MCP server's runtime prerequisite when asked to enable it
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Enabling a server whose npx/uvx runtime is present just works; when absent offer the install command. Tests zc_mcp_autoinstall_*.
